name: rn-starter-skills
description: React Native skills for Claude Code: machine setup and new apps, ticket analysis and building, screens from designs, mocks to a real API, Maestro E2E flows, and EAS release setup.

plugins.name: rn-starter
plugins.description: Six skills: rn-starter (clean machine to running app), rn-feature (ticket analysis and building, against design and API), rn-ui (screens from text, screenshots or Figma), rn-api-connect (mocks to a real API from OpenAPI, sign-in), rn-e2e (Maestro flows per requirement) and rn-release-setup (EAS and store credentials for TestFlight and Google Play).
